title: Underwriting Limits by Tier — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail
content:
**Credit Policy Manual, Schedule of Underwriting Limits — Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract**

The limits below apply to a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract according to the tier it is booked on.

| Tier | Maximum advance (percent of value basis) | Maximum payment-to-income (percent) | Minimum down payment (percent of selling price) | Funding window (calendar days) | Relationship exposure cap | Maximum vehicle age (years) | Maximum odometer (miles) | Certified Pre-Owned APR reduction (points) | Non-Kestrel make APR adder (points) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 5 | 100 | 12 | 20 | 30 | $35000.00 | 7 | 85000 | 0.5 | 1.5 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 4 | 110 | 13 | 15 | 30 | $45000.00 | 8 | 90000 | 0.5 | 1.5 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 3 | 115 | 15 | 10 | 30 | $65000.00 | 8 | 100000 | 0.75 | 1.25 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 2 | 120 | 16 | 5 | 30 | $90000.00 | 9 | 110000 | 0.75 | 1.0 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1 | 125 | 18 | 0 | 30 | $120000.00 | 10 | 120000 | 1.0 | 0.75 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1+ | 130 | 20 | 0 | 30 | $160000.00 | 10 | 125000 | 1.0 | 0.75 |

### What each figure measures

- **Maximum advance**: the most that may be advanced, as a percent of the vehicle value basis; for a pre-owned vehicle the value basis is the wholesale book value.
- **Maximum payment-to-income**: the highest scheduled payment allowed, as a percent of verified gross monthly income.
- **Minimum down payment**: the cash or trade equity down payment required, as a percent of the selling price. A figure of 0 means no minimum down payment.
- **Funding window**: the calendar days after the contract date within which the dealer must deliver a complete contract package for the contract to be funded.
- **Relationship exposure cap**: the maximum combined Kestrel consumer exposure for the customer, the new contract included, in US dollars.
- **Maximum vehicle age**: the contract year minus the model year, in years.
- **Maximum odometer**: the highest odometer reading at contract the tier may finance.
- **Certified Pre-Owned APR reduction**: percentage points subtracted from the rate-sheet APR for a Kestrel Certified Pre-Owned vehicle.
- **Non-Kestrel make APR adder**: percentage points added to the rate-sheet APR for a used vehicle of another make.

### Points of reference

- Tier 1 and Tier 1+ carry no minimum down payment; Tier 5 requires a fifth of the selling price.
- The funding window is 30 calendar days on every tier.
- The Certified Pre-Owned reduction and the non-Kestrel make adder are stated in percentage points of APR, not as a percent of the rate.
